account.signOutConfirm: Sign out of Sport Talent on this device?

restart.title: Restart to switch to {language}?
restart.body: The app needs to restart to change the reading direction. We’ll save your drafts first.
restart.pending: The new language will be used after you restart.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.safetyLocked: Always on. We’re required to tell you about account decisions.
notifications.osOff: Notifications are off in your device settings.

privacy.title: Privacy and safety
privacy.showReliabilityHelp: Hosts always see your reliability when you ask to join their game.

location.title: Location
location.preciseHelp: Used only while the app is open, to check you in and to show games near you.

background.title: Check in automatically
background.help: Lets Sport Talent use your location in the background to notice when you arrive at a game you joined. It only looks near the venue, around game time.

data.help: Ask for a copy of your data. We’ll let you know when it’s ready.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deleting your account is permanent. You can’t undo it.
delete.deleted: Your profile, photo, phone number, chat messages and the games you haven’t played yet.
delete.kept: Records of warnings and bans are kept in a form that doesn’t identify you, so the rules stay fair for everyone. We keep them only as long as the law allows.
delete.confirmOtp: Or confirm with a code we text to {phone}.
delete.webLink: You can also delete your account on the web: {url}
